items.prompt: Given an array of integers and k, find the maximum average of any k consecutive elements.
items.why: Contiguous + fixed size k → fixed sliding window with a running sum.

items.prompt: Given a sorted array, find two numbers that add up to a target.
items.why: Pairs in a sorted array, not a contiguous run → two pointers moving inward from both ends.

items.prompt: Find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeating characters.
items.why: Longest contiguous substring with a condition you can maintain (a set/map of chars in the window) → dynamic window.

items.prompt: Return the k largest elements of an unsorted array (in any order).
items.why: Not contiguous — 'k largest anywhere' → size-k min-heap (Top 'K' Elements).

items.prompt: Count the subarrays whose sum equals k; the array may contain negative numbers.
items.why: With negatives, adding an element can decrease the sum, so 'shrink while sum ≥ k' is wrong. Use prefix sums + a hash map of seen prefix sums.

items.prompt: Find the smallest window of s that contains every character of t (with multiplicity).
items.why: Shortest contiguous window satisfying a coverage condition → dynamic window; shrink while still valid and record inside the shrink loop.

items.prompt: Find the length of the longest common subsequence of two strings.
items.why: Subsequence (not contiguous) across two strings → 2-D DP, not a window.

items.prompt: You may replace at most k characters; return the longest substring of one repeated letter you can get.
items.why: Longest contiguous substring under a budget (window length − max count ≤ k) → dynamic window.
